  requires val >= 0
  requires 0 <= col
  requires col < len(row)
  ensures len(result) == len(row)
  ensures result[col] == val
  ensures forall j in 0..len(row): ((not (j != col)) or (result[j] == row[j]))
  ensures forall x in result: (x >= 0)
  effects pure
  example modify_row([1, 2, 3], 1, 5) == [1, 5, 3]
{
  if col == 0 then
    match row {
      [_, ..t] => [val] ++ t
      [] => []
    }
  else
    match row {
      [] => []
      [h, ..t] => [h] ++ modify_row(t, col - 1, val)
    }
}

fn replace_at_index(lst: List[List[Int]], idx: Int, new_val: List[Int]) -> List[List[Int]]
  requires forall x in lst: forall x1 in x: (x1 >= 0)
  requires forall x in new_val: (x >= 0)
  requires 0 <= idx
  requires idx < len(lst)
  requires len(new_val) == len(lst[idx])
  ensures len(result) == len(lst)
  ensures result[idx] == new_val
  ensures len(result[idx]) == len(new_val)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(lst): ((not (i != idx)) or (result[i] == lst[i]))
  ensures forall x in result: forall x1 in x: (x1 >= 0)
  effects pure
  example replace_at_index([[1, 2], [3, 4]], 0, [5, 6]) == [[5, 6], [3, 4]]
{
  match lst {
    [] => []
    [h, ..t] => 
      if idx == 0 then
        [new_val] ++ t
      else
        [h] ++ replace_at_index(t, idx - 1, new_val)
  }
}

fn modify_array_impl(arr: List[List[Int]], row: Int, col: Int, val: Int) -> List[List[Int]]
  requires forall x in arr: forall x1 in x: (x1 >= 0)
  requires val >= 0
  requires 0 <= row
  requires row < len(arr)
  requires 0 <= col
  requires col < len(arr[row])
  ensures len(result) == len(arr)
  ensures forall i in 0..len(arr): ((not (i != row)) or (result[i] == arr[i]))
  ensures len(result[row]) == len(arr[row])
  ensures forall j in 0..len(arr[row]): ((not (j != col)) or (result[row][j] == arr[row][j]))
  ensures result[row][col] == val
  ensures forall x in result: forall x1 in x: (x1 >= 0)
  effects pure
  example modify_array_impl([[1, 2], [3, 4]], 0, 1, 5) == [[1, 5], [3, 4]]
{
  replace_at_index(arr, row, modify_row(arr[row], col, val))
}

  requires forall x in arr: forall x1 in x: (x1 >= 0)
  requires (val >= 0)
  requires (0 <= index1)
  requires (index1 < len(arr))

  ensures forall x in result: forall x1 in x: (x1 >= 0)
  effects pure
  example ModifyArrayElement([[1, 2], [3, 4]], 0, 1, 5) == [[1, 5], [3, 4]]

fn get_at(lst: List[List[Int]], idx: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires 0 <= idx
  requires idx < len(lst)
  ensures result == lst[idx]
  effects pure
  example get_at([[1, 2], [3, 4]], 0) == [1, 2]
  example get_at([[1, 2], [3, 4]], 1) == [3, 4]
{
  match lst {
    [] => []
    [h, ..t] => if idx == 0 then h else get_at(t, idx - 1)
  }
}
